nodes.label: Game Launch V1 Seamless
nodes.rationale: Seamless mode for game integration with automatic bet settlement

nodes.label: Game Launch V2 Transfer
nodes.rationale: Transfer mode supporting deposit, withdrawal, and balance query

nodes.label: Bet Settlement Callback
nodes.rationale: Server-to-server callback for real-time bet settlement

nodes.label: AES256 Encryption
nodes.rationale: All payloads encrypted using AES-256-ECB + PKCS7 + Base64

nodes.label: OKPay Deposit Webhook
nodes.rationale: Processes OKPay deposit callbacks with signature verification

nodes.label: OKPay Withdrawal Webhook
nodes.rationale: Handles withdrawal callbacks with automatic refund on failure

nodes.label: OKPay MD5 Signature
nodes.rationale: MD5 signature with URL encoding and lowercase conversion

nodes.label: Referral System Design
nodes.rationale: 10% referral bonus (max ₹2,000) with self-referral prevention via IP and email validation, 7-day qualification window

nodes.label: Welcome Bonus Design
nodes.rationale: 100% deposit match (max ₹10,000) with 20x wagering requirement, 30-day expiry, single claim per account

nodes.label: VIP Tier System Design
nodes.rationale: 5-tier system (Bronze→Silver→Gold→Platinum→Diamond) based on total wagered only (not wins), no downgrades, bonus multipliers 1.0x-2.0x

nodes.label: Atomic Balance Updates Pattern
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for balance changes using optimistic locking via balanceVersion to prevent race conditions

nodes.label: Optimistic Locking Pattern
nodes.rationale: Version-based optimistic locking (balanceVersion, statsVersion) with retry loop (max 5) to prevent race conditions

nodes.label: Idempotency Pattern
nodes.rationale: Redis-based idempotency keys prevent duplicate transaction processing in aggregator-adapter, wallet-service, and transaction router

nodes.label: Bonus Wagering Distribution
nodes.rationale: Active bonuses share wagering proportionally to prevent abuse, formula: (betAmount × bonusRemaining) / totalRemaining

nodes.label: VIP Progress on Bets Only
nodes.rationale: VIP tier upgrades track total wagered (not wins) - earned by play, not by receiving money

nodes.label: Mobile-First Design
nodes.rationale: App optimized for mobile viewport (max-w-md mx-auto) with bottom navigation and safe-area handling

nodes.label: Proportional Wagering Distribution
nodes.rationale: Each bet distributed across active bonuses based on remaining requirement to prevent bonus abuse
